subject: Companies Registry Letter - Harbour Light Limited
body:
Dear Ms Ann Ho,

We have received a letter from the Companies Registry for Harbour Light Limited. It is a reminder notice regarding the overdue delivery of the company's Annual Return (Form NAR1) for 2026.

The letter requires the company to deliver the annual return (Form NAR1) together with the appropriate fee without delay. A scanned copy of the letter is attached for your reference.

Please let us know if you would like us to assist in preparing and filing the annual return on your behalf.

Best regards,
CWC CPA
